segments.name: Travelzoo North America

segments.evidence: Travelzoo North America consists of the Company's operations in the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: Travelzoo Europe
segments.description: Runs Travelzoo's club and advertising operations in France, Germany, Spain and the UK for travel enthusiasts and travel advertisers.
segments.evidence: Travelzoo Europe consists of the Company's operations in France, Germany, Spain, and the UK.

segments.description: Sells subscriptions to premium members who receive exceptional airfare deals by email and mobile applications.
segments.evidence: Jack's Flight Club consists of subscription revenue from premium members to access and receive flight deals via email or mobile applications.
